item.title: Schema & Structured Data for WP & AMP Unauthenticated Unrestricted File Upload (CVE-2026-9067)

Affected Target

Field Value

Language / Platform PHP / WordPress (AJAX)
Authentication Required No
Network Access Required Yes

Summary

The plugin’s saswp_rf_form_image_upload AJAX handler does not validate the requesting user’s capability nor properly validate the uploaded file’s type, allowing an unauthenticated attacker to upload arbitrary files (with a spoofed MIME type/extension) to the WordPress uploads directory. WordPress core still blocks execution of dangerous file types (.php, .phtml, .html, .svg) in the uploads directory, so this does not directly yield remote code execution, but it enables hosting arbitrary content (malware, phishing pages), disk-space exhaustion, and reputation abuse from the victim’s domain.
